question: Who is ranked as the richest person in India according to the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mukesh Ambani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mukesh Ambani__, Chairman of Reliance Industries, is once again ranked as India’s richest person with a net worth of __₹9.55 lakh crore__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2025__, Ambani’s net worth surpasses that of __Gautam Adani__, who ranks second with ₹8.15 lakh crore.**
 
• **The 14th edition of the list shows India’s growing billionaire base, with over __350 billionaires__, a sixfold increase since the list’s inception.**
 
• **__Aravind Srinivas__, the youngest billionaire in India at __31 years old__, has a net worth of ₹21,190 crore.**
 
• **Notable first-time entrants include __Shah Rukh Khan__, with a net worth of ₹12,490 crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **M3M Hurun India Rich List**__

 __
 
• This annual list ranks the wealthiest individuals in India, offering insight into the growth and distribution of wealth within the country.
 
• The list is jointly compiled by Hurun Research Institute and M3M India, with a focus on billionaires and their assets across various sectors.
 
 
 
• **India’s Billionaires**__
 __
 
• India now has more than 350 billionaires__, reflecting the country’s increasing economic influence and wealth creation.
 
 
 
• __**Younger Entrepreneurs**__
 __
 
• Young entrepreneurs such as Aravind Srinivas__, __Kaivalya Vohra__, and __Aadit Palicha__ are becoming significant figures in India’s rapidly evolving business landscape.
 
 
 
• __**Shah Rukh Khan’s Wealth**__
 __
 
• Shah Rukh Khan__, a prominent Bollywood actor, enters the rich list for the first time, highlighting the growing wealth of entertainers in India.
